For [formats](/docs/shell/commands/categories/formats/).

<div class='command-title'>Hex encode a binary value or a string.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> encode hex {flags} ```

## Flags

 -  `--lower`: Encode to lowercase hex.


## Input/output types:

| input  | output |
| ------ | ------ |
| string | string |
| binary | string |
## Examples

Encode a binary value
```nu
> 0x[C3 06] | encode hex
C306
```

Encode a string
```nu
> "hello" | encode hex
68656C6C6F
```

Output a Lowercase version of the encoding
```nu
> 0x[AD EF] | encode hex --lower
adef
```
